Ground Truth | Report Library

We Retested Our AI Trading Bot Claim

REGISTERED RESULT: BROKEN - OUR CLAIM WITHDRAWN

Counting interactions broke our earlier claim that the surrounding setup mattered far more than the model. The registered model factor includes a random picker. This is not a verdict for or against AI trading skill. The positive control is INDETERMINATE: this instrument has not demonstrated that it distinguishes a genuine edge from pick noise.

An AI trading bot here is a program that scores stocks from price and volume history. A backtest simulates its rules on old prices. We compare choices within one restricted grid, not the potential of all AI models and not a live account.

Source inspiration: LosingLoonies, "I Used Trees to Predict Stock Prices". LosingLoonies is a respected origin of the described setup. We rebuilt that shape with our own features, labels and fill rules; we did not inspect or run the offered code, reproduce its figures, or adjudicate its performance. The source discusses limitations and offers code through GitHub Sponsors. This report corrects our own lab.

Design and chronology | Decision rules | Control | Random picks | Limits | Every cell | What would change our mind

The plan, its chronology and the prior

The corrected plan was locked at commit 0d65ef4 on 2026-09-30, before the corrected model results. Earlier lab results had already been seen. Amendments one through three preceded scoring; amendment four followed the computed verdict and introduced reporting means and a numerical convention for the omega wording. Those additions are post hoc, not pre-registered. No numerical probability prior is specified for this corrected run. The old figures supply history, not evidence for this report.

The earlier lab omitted interactions and carried defective sequence windows, mismatched benchmark spans, reused random streams and a confounded stock-list contrast. The corrected run changes those mechanics. A current agreement cannot prove that the unrecorded amendment-four before/after assertion executed at the time; that missing historical record is a permanent limit.

Design itemRegistered choice and meaning
DataLocal Massive/Polygon daily US equity bars, splits, dividends and current ticker/CIK reference, pinned through 2026-06-22; 27 input files and the loader were hash-bound. Panel begins 2004-01-02. All returns are nominal US-dollar price returns unless explicitly labelled otherwise.
Stock listsPIT: each day's common stocks with raw close at least $5 and dollar volume at least $5 million, top 1,000 by dollar volume. SURV: securities in that list on 2026-06-22, back-filled without the historical screens. This combines hindsight membership and screening differences; it is not a pure survivorship effect.
Eligibility and featuresEvery model needs 60 consecutive feature-complete bars of a security. Ten inputs: returns over 1/5/21/63/126 bars, volatility over 21/63, distance from the 21/200-bar average, and 63-bar raw-volume z-score. Warm-up can require substantially more than 60 raw bars.
TrainingAnnual expanding-window refits in 2008-2026; purged horizon labels end before the test year. The same eligible anchors enter each model; cap 400,000 sampled rows and minimum 5,000. Logistic regression, gradient-boosted trees, and LSTM trained for one epoch; the historical implementation used three epochs. This is not a tuned architecture comparison.
Labels and selectionLabel is above the own-universe median traded return. Fixed holding horizons of 1, 21 or 126 trading days, or pick the horizon with the highest best score. Seeded ties; pick one stock or an equally weighted basket of ten.
ExecutionDecide at close t, fill at close t+1, exit after the selected horizon. Empty or missing-fill sleeves remain cash earning zero. The fill day earns zero before charges. No leverage or shorting; held gaps book the gap return on resumption.
Cost0, 5, 10 or 20 basis points per round trip, applied as half that rate times one-way turnover at fills and final liquidation. Same names re-picked do not pay a full new round trip. No market impact or capacity model.
Window and benchmarkEvery strategy and SPY starts at the first fill close, 2008-01-03, and ends 2026-06-22. Sharpe uses daily mean/sample standard deviation x sqrt(252), risk-free rate zero; CAGR uses calendar years; drawdown includes starting equity before the initial charge. Both primary sides omit dividends.
Identity and endingsPieces separated by gaps above 20 SPY-calendar index days can be joined by a pre-stated same-ticker/CIK and split-adjusted price-ratio rule. Current CIK/type, no-gap reuse and missing actions remain limits. True ends sell at last close; a registered sensitivity applies a further 30% loss.
FactorialFive factors: model, stock list, selection, concentration, cost. WITH has random/logistic/GBT/LSTM trained for one epoch; NO is the same saved cells with that last arm omitted, not a new run. 256 versus 192 cells per seed; three seeds on one market history.
Deliberately NOT testedNo offered-code replication, stock total-return test, live execution, train-versus-trade causal split, independent-market test, strategy search or general AI-skill verdict.

All 31 main and interaction terms exhaust the variation in net Sharpe across the chosen settings. M sums terms containing model; its complement sums setup-only terms. Total effects for different factors overlap through interactions, so their shares do not sum to one. These are shares of configuration variance, not shares of profit, returns, causation or skill. Was the alarm demonstrated to distinguish signal?

The rank alarm was already on in the real grid and remains on at every planted level listed below. The overall control rule requires the breaker on at the registered edge and off at zero dose; the second condition is absent. Thus INDETERMINATE is the registered outcome. Calibration of a dose is a separate question from discriminating signal.

For the model line including the random picker, every planted level is accounted for: IC 0.00 (zero-signal diagnostic) has a size trigger in 0 of 3 seeds WITH and 0 of 3 seeds NO, and the model total-effect rank stays third in 6 of 6 seed/variant pairs (WITH and NO); IC 0.01 (weaker planted edge) has a size trigger in 0 of 3 seeds WITH and 0 of 3 seeds NO, and the model total-effect rank stays third in 6 of 6 seed/variant pairs (WITH and NO); IC 0.03 (registered planted edge) has a size trigger in 3 of 3 seeds WITH and 3 of 3 seeds NO, and the model total-effect rank rises from third to first in 6 of 6 seed/variant pairs (WITH and NO); IC 0.10 (stronger planted edge) has a size trigger in 3 of 3 seeds WITH and 3 of 3 seeds NO, and the model total-effect rank rises from third to first in 6 of 6 seed/variant pairs (WITH and NO). These pairs share one market history; the rank change does not establish skill or change BROKEN or INDETERMINATE.

Later model-line checks

In a post-hoc check, not pre-registered, removing the random picker leaves the trained-only model line fourth of five in 3 of three seeds with LSTM trained for one epoch and 3 of three without that arm. In a separate post-hoc check, not pre-registered, a line containing only random pickers ranks fifth of five in 57 of 57 constructions from the saved grid cells. Those constructions share one history and are dependent; this is not the larger null-table family, an independent-trial count, a skill verdict or a restoration of our old claim. The two checks leave BROKEN and INDETERMINATE unchanged.

Before dividends, NULL-SRC's median growth is 9.31% versus SPY's 9.27%, with 50% of 100 draws beating SPY; both omit stock dividends. Median Sharpe is 0.423 versus 0.546, with 20% of 100 draws ahead. Median drawdown is -79.59% versus -52.98%, with 0% of 100 draws shallower, all before dividends. These are different questions; growth alone is not the result.

Adding dividends to SPY raises its CAGR to 11.30% and reverses that median growth ordering. This is asymmetric because the random stocks' dividends remain uncounted; the price-only growth beat share above is not a beat share against dividend-inclusive SPY. The doubling check fails and is CONFIRMATORY, NOT BLIND: earlier results were seen, and this check has no role in the registered verdict.

PIT changes only the stock list; TOP10 changes only concentration; 20BPS changes only cost; PIT-TOP10-20BPS changes all three. SURV_S applies each-day price/liquidity screens to the hindsight list. TOP10, PIT-TOP10-20BPS and SURV_S are table-derived because their daily paths were not retained under the artifact cap. Other displayed null distributions were recomputed from saved daily paths.

Data, audit boundaries and later reconstruction

The daily store comes from Massive/Polygon; the benchmark is SPY daily closes and its ex-date dividend records. Current ticker/type and CIK records cannot recover a dated security master: the old Facebook history is absent under its current ETF type, no-gap reuse can remain, and historical continuations may be missed. Raw prices undo ticker-level splits for the price floor; features use chained split-adjusted security closes and raw volume. Stocks' dividend coverage is unverified before 2017, so constituent dividends are excluded. SPY's dividend sensitivity passed the registered full-year ex-date/split checks, but is still asymmetric.

Price hygiene was fixed before the corrected run: nonpositive/nonfinite closes are dropped; isolated spikes against both neighbours are removed (factor 1.5 for stocks, 1.10 for SPY); suspected unadjusted split returns are not booked; out-of-range closes are counted. The spike rule looks one close forward and can remove genuine events, limiting a prospective trading interpretation. Split-affected features can remain distorted. Last-close liquidation is not a recovered delisting return. No impact, borrowing, capacity or changing risk-free rate was modelled.

For this report, a later CPU reconstruction on the pinned inputs recovered the previously owed eligibility count: 5,652 of 5,652 panel dates lose at least one pre-eligibility member, totaling 329,934 removed slot-days. This reproduces the original marginal using the exact mask, rather than a cap-deficit shortcut. It is reconstruction after the run, not an original gate record. Row identities, eligibility flags and candidate populations agree with the retained cache; no model, path, threshold or verdict was rerun.

All 27,648 of 27,648 exported cell statistics agree across 4,608 rows. This certifies arithmetic against saved artifacts, not upstream model construction, economic validity or independence. Two altered-number controls were rejected first. No independent report audit is implied.

Every saved grid cell and downloadable evidence

The ledger contains 4,608 rows: three seeds x eight score levels (four real, including random, plus four diagnostic oracles) x two lists x four selection rules x two concentrations x four costs x three cost/end conventions. The primary real-model WITH grid has 768 rows; NO is its 576-row subset. Oracle rows and descriptive sensitivities are labelled, not mixed into the real-model verdict. CAGR, volatility and drawdown are decimal fractions; Sharpe is a ratio; turnover and rebalances are per year. The CSV carries full precision.

What would change our mind

A documented upstream defect that changes the registered arithmetic reopens this result. Restoring the old dominance claim requires a fresh preregistered corrected run that clears the existing main-effects bar, leaves both Q4 criteria silent, and demonstrates the specified control discrimination: the planted edge triggers the breaker and the zero-signal construction does not. Fixes and any new thresholds must be declared before that run. A published reproducible specimen could answer the separate replication question. Neither has been run here.

This report includes detail and later reconstructions beyond the approved episode. The neural-network-omitted grid uses the same saved cells as a subset; it is not a second run. The video omits four unspoken aggregates and a pending-note label; nothing here asserts those were shown on screen.
